g.title: blend-unwind
g.text: Blend V1 / V2 · supply (bToken) · borrow (dToken) · backstop · via @blend-capital/blend-sdk

g.title: detect
g.text: Supply (bTokens) · Debt (dTokens) · Backstop · per-pool health factors

g.title: ver
g.text: V1 (older pools) or V2 (newer pools) · unknown wasmHash: position blocked with explanation

g.title: emissions
g.text: User offered to claim before exit (OctoPos does not report emissions)

g.title: has_debt
g.text: dTokens represent borrowed assets · must be repaid before collateral withdrawal

g.title: has_asset
g.text: Account must hold the borrowed token to repay

g.title: withdraw
g.text: Supplied and collateralized balances tracked separately - correct request type per position
Pass amount greater than balance: clamps to actual balance for a full exit with no dust

g.title: acquire
g.text: Route via Soroswap API or SDEX path payment
Swap XLM (or another held asset) for the borrowed token at current market rate

g.title: repay
g.text: Blend pulls exact stated amount · refunds any excess in same tx
Tool caps repay at balance held - avoids overdraft

g.title: hf
g.text: Protocol rejects withdrawal that would undercollateralize remaining positions

g.title: hf_block
g.text: Shown in plain language · user must repay more before tool can proceed

g.title: backstop
g.text: Backstop is the pool's insurance layer - separate from supply

g.title: done
g.text: bTokens redeemed · dToken debt cleared · proceeds in XLM

g.title: queue_start
g.text: Call withdraw on the backstop module
V1: 21-day cooldown · V2: 17-day cooldown · Backstop token = BLND:USDC 80/20 Comet LP share

g.title: q4w_wait
g.text: User warned funds unavailable until cooldown ends · shown remaining time
